source_text: Moyses ad Aegyptum mittitur prodigia facturus. Et ego, si exii mente, redeo ad fratres adhuc servientes, verbum liberationis portans — non ut Aegyptus placeat, sed ut populus exeat.
pass_a_gloss: Moses to Egypt is-sent wonders about-to-do. And I, if I-exited by-mind, return to brothers still serving, word of-liberation carrying — not that Egypt may-please, but that people may-exit.
pass_b_english: Moses is sent back into Egypt to work the wonders God put in his hand. So too, if we have left Egypt in mind, we return in word to brothers still enslaved — not to make Egypt pleasant, but to call a people out.
